thread:
samir: Starting a small quickstart cleanup for 'hello-sprint'. Goals: single-command local run, unify env var names to SPRINT_API_KEY, fix the broken SDK v9 link, and add a tiny /health smoke test. I'll open a draft PR under examples/hello-sprint.

lorna: One-command flow should be `cp .env.sample .env && npm ci && npm run dev`. Keep Docker snippet but make npm path easiest.

samir: Yep. I'll add .env.sample and a start script that loads dotenv but respects real env vars (so CI secrets override). Snippet I'll include:```bash
# .env.sample
SPRINT_API_KEY=your_token_here
SPRINT_REGION=us-west1
```

hao: Please add a short migration note for older examples that used LEGACY_API_TOKEN. People keep tripping on the name mismatch.

samir: Will add: "Migration: if you used LEGACY_API_TOKEN, set SPRINT_API_KEY to its value or rename your CI secret."

lorna: Also replace the dead SDK link with https://sdk.redwood.ai/v9/quickstart and add docs CI linkcheck to fail on 404s.

link-bot: queued: docs/linkcheck on PR draft.

hao: For reviewers: @lorna take CI/linkcheck, @samir handles example code and README, I'll do copy + screenshots.

samir: Draft PR #5342 created. PR checklist: - add examples/hello-sprint with start script - include .env.sample - update README quick run steps - update SDK link to v9 - add migration note for LEGACY_API_TOKEN - add docs CI linkcheck job - add examples/test/smoke.test.js asserting GET /health => 200 - keep minimal Dockerfile stanza for on-prem docs - update screenshot alt text for accessibility

link-bot: linkcheck: external links OK. examples smoke: failing (pre-fix).

samir: Pushed fix to start server to expose /health and re-ran CI. Start script uses dotenv and logs listening port.

link-bot: examples smoke: passing. linkcheck: OK.

lorna: Small copy suggestion: prefer "token" in prose but keep env var SPRINT_API_KEY. I'll push a tiny wording patch.

hao: LGTM. CI looks good. Merge when docs review approves.

samir: Addressed wording nit and pushed. Requesting final review.

lorna: Approved.

samir: Merged PR #5342. Will announce in #announcements after the docs site rebuild. Thanks!
